text:
Noah: Tiny contest idea  name the office plant, but the catch: the name must be generated by an LLM persona. winner gets primo parking. :seedling:
Sana: love it. propose persona: "overly dramatic bard". please deliver a name and a one-line origin myth. :scroll: :sparkles:
Eli: I'll run a privacy-safe prompt on the tiny model. results in 5 min. who wants to judge? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ruth: I'll judge. tie-breaker = best mythology. also GIFs encouraged. :trophy:
Noah: prompt I plan to use: ```You are an imaginative bard. Give a whimsical one-word name for a potted plant and a 10-word origin myth. Keep it office-friendly.```
Sana: ha, love the constraints. Eli: let us know if the model invents lore about the printer.
Eli: result 1 (Bard persona): "Whispergrove — Born from spilled coffee, hums during 3pm meetings." :thinking_face:
Eli: result 2 (Pragmatic admin persona): "Green-1 — Assigned tag: Asset #297. Water weekly." :memo:
Ruth: hard choice. Whispergrove is peak lore; Green-1 is efficient. Voting emoji time.
Noah: Whispergrove :heart:
Sana: Green-1 :ok_hand:
Eli: depends-on-mood :shrug:
Ruth: Whispergrove wins by 2 votes. congrats. Toby (the plant formerly unlabeled) is now Whispergrove. :confetti_ball:
Noah: micro follow-up: best office-safe system prompt to make models more charming without hallucinating? here's mine: `Adopt a playful tone, never invent facts, cite uncertainty, keep answers under 30 words.`
Sana: mine: `Respond like a friendly colleague. If unsure, prefix with "I might be wrong" and suggest next steps.` :coffee:
Eli: runner-up prompt (for chaos): `Write everything as a weather report. creativity encouraged.` (dangerously delightful) :cloud_with_rain:
OfficeBot: Reminder: please update the asset tracker with Whispergrove's new name. Also, plants appreciate sunlight. (automated) :robot_face:
Ruth: quick meme: worst plant-care performance review in one line: "Consistently photosynthesizes below expectations; needs better Zoom presence." :joy:
Sana: "Shows enthusiasm for sunlight; tendency to nap during sprint demos." :rofl:
Noah: thanks y'all. tiny victory for office lore. I'll make a tiny label: Whispergrove, Custodian of Coffee Spills. :label: 
Eli: will involve sticker printer. party at break table in 10.
Noah: bring stickers, bring prompts, bring snacks. :wave:
